aboutGame.title: What is Aftergods?
paragraphs: Aftergods is a top-down mythic survival action RPG where players rise as Godborn champions in the aftermath of cosmic cataclysm. Explore dangerous ruined realms, rebuild sacred sanctums around the shattered World Tree, rally mortal survivors, and master ancient celestial abilities.

Whether conquering ferocious mythical titans solo or coordinating synergistic frontline, blaster, and support roles in multiplayer co-op, our comprehensive wiki covers weapon tiers, boss patterns, class progression, and survival mechanics.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Aftergods.

items.question: What is Aftergods?
items.answer: Aftergods is an upcoming top-down survival action RPG developed by Norsfell. Players step into the shoes of Godborn heroes navigating a ruined mythic world after Ragnarök, rebuilding the World Tree, gathering mortal survivors, and battling divine terrors.

items.question: Which starter archetype is best for beginners in Aftergods?
items.answer: The Vanguard archetype is widely recommended for new players due to its forgiving health pool, high poise defense, and durable posture against heavy attacks.

items.question: Does Aftergods support multiplayer co-op?
items.answer: Yes, Aftergods features cooperative multiplayer for 2 to 4 players, allowing friends to combine complementary archetypes, trigger elemental combos, and tackle scaled boss raids.

items.question: What platforms is Aftergods releasing on?
items.answer: Aftergods is planned for PC via Steam and modern home consoles including PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, along with support for handheld PCs like the Steam Deck.

items.question: How does combat stamina and Divine Resonance work in Aftergods?
items.answer: Combat relies on balanced stamina management and building Divine Resonance through attacks and parries. Depleting stamina enters an exhaustion state, while full resonance unleashes potent relic skills.
